notes: 14 manual browser cases executed against the deployed main app, not the tracking checkout. The four HTTP cases are in local-20261015-http-current. New synthetic collection, fixture, chat and unpublished assistant draft are intentionally retained for sponsor review; no schedule was created. The ingestion failure and subsequent unassisted recovery are both preserved; no root cause or fix is claimed. After reauthentication the original automated tab stopped responding to navigation activation; a fresh normal Chrome tab reopened the persisted chat successfully. This isolated observation is not assigned a product cause. Single owner/tenant, desktop browser, one model route and one TXT fixture only; this run does not establish full catalog-area coverage.
